html:
The Yinwum are an Aboriginal people of Cape York Peninsula in Queensland, in country inland from the west coast in the middle of the peninsula.

Their neighbours on the map include the Luthigh, the Mpalitjanh and the Kaanju. Their language is poorly recorded and no longer spoken. Little else is written about them as a separate group. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
sum: The Yinwum are an Aboriginal people of Cape York Peninsula in Queensland, in country inland from the west coast in the middle of the peninsula.
